scientific_limitations: The statement concerns finite undirected weighted adjacency wheels with n>=3 and real g>0 only.
Cesaro-limit spectra are exact; finite-time mixing and detuning scales are not quantified.
Kimmerling already proved unweighted windmill rank parity; this result does not claim unweighted parity as new.
Originality has residual overlap risk because the dissertation full text was not fully retrievable and a general spectral join formula might imply the classification.
